No strong reference mode is missing in 60-722 cm-1. Score 0.987. Only three bands constrain the fit, and no experimental reference was checked, so this is a computed-spectrum match, not a confirmed identity.

hint_reasoning: No material hint was given, so there is no stated material to verify. The identification is a library-match ranking. The top candidate (ClInO, Pmmn) matches all three measured bands but is supported only by three peaks and a DFT reference.

limits: Quality: rl_qc reported no flags. No cosmic-ray spikes, no saturation, no Si line in the window. The analysis window was 60-722 cm-1 at 1 cm-1 spacing, so modes below 60 or above 722 cm-1 are not covered. Signal to noise is about 68 on the strongest band.

Band count: the fit found three bands. I checked the summed spectrum for weaker bands. After subtracting the three Lorentzians, the residual features at about 163, 383 and 592 cm-1 are comparable to noise elsewhere (for example the empty 400-722 cm-1 region). A band weaker than roughly 3-5% of the 353 cm-1 peak cannot be excluded. A lowered-threshold rl_fit run did not finish, and I stopped it. Its output is not used.

Identification strength: three peaks with a fitted frequency scale (1.02) leave substantial room for chance matches. The top candidate has no experimental reference spectrum behind it, and I did not run a literature search (Valency or iopic-bond). The candidate is therefore weakly supported. The data alone cannot confirm the material.
Working-directory name: the folder path contains 'InOCl', which matches the top candidate's formula. I did not use this for the identification. The identification rests on the spectral match only.

Polarization: the 155.3 cm-1 band is isotropic (parallel flat, crossed near zero). An Ag mode of an orthorhombic crystal normally has an anisotropic in-plane tensor and would show a twofold pattern. The 155.3 cm-1 band's isotropic behaviour does not fit a generic Pmmn Ag assignment, so it is an unresolved conflict with the CRD label. It could mean an accidental a≈b tensor, a different in-plane geometry, or a wrong assignment. The crossed-configuration values are noisy and not all zero, so the isotropic_par_only class is a tool classification and not a precise measurement. The twofold classes for 298.96 and 352.91 cm-1 are consistent with an anisotropic Ag tensor in a plane.

Irreps are the CRD labels (Ag for all three). The labels were not checked against a full mode table for the candidate; only the matched modes were compared. Sample orientation relative to the crystal axes is unknown, so the polarization classes are not tied to a crystal direction.

Relations: none applied. No layer, strain, doping or defect relation exists for this candidate material in the skill's reference notes, and no material note exists for ClInO / InOCl. Properties above are inferred or left undetermined.

Conditions taken from the metadata: 532 nm, 295 K, suspended, backscattering along the layer normal. These were not checked against the data. The 532 nm excitation is not checked against any resonance of the candidate.
